identity: A team project workspace with a dated task timeline and a delivery board for moving work between columns and team lanes.

scenarios.name: gantt-move
scenarios.screen: A calendar timeline shows named task rows with dated bars, a date scale, and a few project rollups. About six tasks are visible at their current start dates; no detail panel or popup is open.
never: A date picker already open over the timeline.
Task bars detached from their rows.
A delivery board in place of the timeline.

arrangements.text: Task names sit to the left of their bars, dates run across the top, and project rollups sit above the timeline.
Task names sit to the left of their bars, dates run across the top, and project rollups sit below the timeline.

scenarios.name: gantt-resize
scenarios.screen: A calendar timeline shows named task rows, bars spanning calendar days, and a resize grip at each bar’s right end. About six tasks are visible with their current durations; no detail panel or popup is open.
never: Bars extending outside the calendar grid.
A delivery board in place of the timeline.

arrangements.text: Task names sit left of the calendar grid, dates run across its top, and the right resize grips line up with the ends of the bars.
The calendar grid sits beside the task names, with project rollups below the task rows and resize grips still at the bars’ right ends.

scenarios.name: dependency
scenarios.screen: A dated task timeline shows named bars, connection points at their ends, and lines for the current finish-to-start links. About six tasks are visible, with no connection menu or detail panel open.
never: A dependency line with an endpoint floating away from a task.
A separate dependency matrix replacing the timeline.

arrangements.text: Task names form a list on the left, dated bars occupy the grid on the right, and link lines run between bar endpoints.
The task list and dated grid remain side by side, with the link count and other project rollups below the grid.

scenarios.name: swimlane
scenarios.screen: A delivery board has status columns crossed with team lanes, with named task cards placed in their current cells. About six cards are visible; no card detail panel or move menu is open.
never: A card already outside the board’s columns.
A dated Gantt chart replacing the board.

arrangements.text: Status headings run across the top, team names run down the left, and cards sit where each column and lane meet.
Status headings run across the top and team names down the left, with board rollups below the card grid.

scenarios.name: wip
scenarios.screen: A delivery board shows named task cards in status columns, with each column’s work-in-progress limit and current card count visible. About six cards are present, including the board’s current column assignments; no card detail panel or move menu is open.
never: A team-lane grid replacing the WIP columns.

arrangements.text: Status columns sit side by side, with each limit and count beside its column heading and cards stacked beneath.
Status columns sit side by side, with limits and counts below their headings and cards stacked beneath those figures.

scenarios.name: milestone
scenarios.screen: A calendar timeline shows named milestone rows and dated diamond markers, with a date scale and project rollups. About six milestones are visible at their current dates; no date picker or detail panel is open.
never: Diamond markers detached from their task rows.

arrangements.text: Milestone names sit left of the calendar grid, dates run across the top, and diamonds align with their rows and dates.
Milestone names remain beside the dated grid, while project rollups sit below the diamond rows.
